resources.string: Share a technical report for one game session. Reports remain available after restarting the app.
No recorded session. Launch a game, then return here to export its diagnostic.
Delete the saved diagnostic for %1$s? This frees storage. Already shared ZIP files are kept.
Could not delete this session. Stop the game and wait for any export to finish, then try again.
Session in progress. The export contains data collected so far.
Session ended. The report may contain errors encountered during the run.
The session stopped without a final status. Its saved data can still be exported.

The ZIP includes device and Vulkan information, settings, logs and performance samples. Missing or limited data is listed in the report. Logs may contain game titles and file paths. Keys and firmware files are excluded.
Could not export or share the diagnostic. Check free storage and try again.
